entries.rationale: The installer runs before the TypeScript payload exists. It needs the same token renderer without importing compiled code.

entries.rationale: The installer must render policy rules before a compiled TypeScript payload exists.

entries.rationale: The operator kept both chunking surfaces. The planner carves ratified scope inside one gate, and the standalone decomposition mode assesses an unratified intake, so each surface needs its own independence and economics rules bound to its own context.
evidence: tests/unit/cohort-plan-validator.test.ts: planner chunking rules are enforced against the planning stage output
tests/integration/planning-workflow.test.ts: the planning stage resolves PLAN-002 and COHORT-001 while the standalone decomposition mode stays bound to DECOMP-001
tests/unit/policies.test.ts: the best-of-N candidate planner resolves PLAN-002 without the COHORT-001 hierarchy rules or their validators

entries.rationale: The mutually exclusive reviewer roles need the same verdict boundary in their independent judgment guidance.
evidence: tests/unit/policies.test.ts: representative review contexts resolve distinct review policy sets

entries.rationale: Each independently invoked entry command must prevent nested supervision before it adopts the shared supervisor persona.
evidence: tests/regression/supervisor-delegation-contract.test.ts: entry commands and always-applied rules share the supervisor invariants

entries.rationale: Only one installation-specific bootstrap rule is projected. Both variants must retain the same supervisor and retrieval invariants.
evidence: tests/unit/projection.test.ts: self-development and embedded projection coverage

entries.rationale: Each language policy independently guards its formatter-owned appendix and can be delivered without the other policy.
Each generated language handbook must state its own bounded unknowns because agents read only guidance for relevant languages.

PLAN-002 consolidates the intake and planning disciplines for the delivery workflow while the design workflow still binds INTAKE-001 to its intake stage. The shared faithful-intake instructions must stay aligned.
evidence: governance/registries/policy_lookup_table.json: design binds INTAKE-001, delivery binds PLAN-002

entries.rationale: The impacted mapping reaches no data path, so each implementation role needs the judgment-cohort recovery on its own card. The lookup table resolves DEV-001 for the coder and REMED-001 for the remediator, and neither policy reaches the other role. A shared owner would put plan-scoped implementation rules on a remediation card.
evidence: tests/unit/test-impact.test.ts: an unmapped change is reported as unreached and raises the advisory
tests/unit/policies.test.ts: policy structure and instruction coverage

entries.rationale: The two remediator personas share the reproduce-repair-prove discipline but carry different authority: the severe variant may amend the plan, the ordinary variant may not. The verify verdict selects exactly one per attempt, so the shared discipline must stay aligned in both.
